The model predictions are very clear:
- Median prediction mean: 0.9971 (very far from tipping point, since 0 = tipping, 1 = far away)
- Last third mean: 0.9981
- Last window: 0.9997
- p_critical mean: 0.0227 (very low probability of being near tipping)
- p_critical last window: 0.0044
- p_critical last third mean: 0.0209
- Share of windows above half: 0.0 (no windows have p_critical > 0.5)

The predictions are consistently near 1 (far from tipping point) throughout the series, including at the end. The p_critical is very low. This strongly indicates "no_alert".

The decision is clearly "no_alert".
